name: Sector Utils
description: Provides utilities, UX, and UI improvements for Sector.
project_description:
This project exists to bridge the gap between Sector 9 and Sector 10 to allow for continued support for features that newer Sector builds no longer support.

 It does not aid in the upgrade process itself and is incompatible for use with Drupal 9.

 In the future it will be updated to continue long-term support for Sector legacy sites as they age.

 Related modules:

 
 Sector Radix Starter (for legacy sites that sub-theme the D8/9 Radix starter theme)
